Apartment Renovation Contractor Atlanta

Build Heritage is your one‑stop general contractor for apartment renovations in metro Atlanta, handling framing, roofing, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, drywall/paint, flooring, and exterior work under one accountable team. We provide a free itemized quote within 48 hours and are licensed and insured in Georgia.

What you get

• Free itemized quote in 48 hours • Licensed & insured in Georgia • Eight trades under one accountable team

Why Build Heritage

Our integrated approach reduces coordination headaches. We serve property managers, apartment communities, HOAs, brokers, and investors in the Atlanta market.

FAQ

Do you offer a free quote? Yes, we provide a free itemized quote within 48 hours of your request.

Are you licensed and insured in Georgia? Yes, Build Heritage is licensed and insured in Georgia.

Next step: Contact us today to schedule your free quote and start your apartment renovation project.
